## What it is

Section index for setting up the third-party services that *Digital Sales Rooms* depends on. It names the two external services and points to a detailed setup procedure for each one in the following pages.

## When to use

You are setting up Digital Sales Rooms and need to configure the external services it requires before the plugin configuration step.

## Key steps / config

- Daily.co (realtime video call): follow the [realtime video call setup](platform/dev/6.7/products/digital-sales-rooms/setup-3rd-party/realtime-video-dailyco.md).
- Mercure (realtime service): follow the [realtime Mercure service setup](platform/dev/6.7/products/digital-sales-rooms/setup-3rd-party/realtime-service-mercure.md).

## Code check (6.7.15.1)
- unverified `Daily.co` — external video service used by Digital Sales Rooms; outside vendor/shopware scope
- unverified `Mercure` — external realtime service used by Digital Sales Rooms; outside vendor/shopware scope
